stories.title: São Paulo segue em alerta de perigo para tempestades neste domingo; veja previsão

en.title: São Paulo remains on storm danger alert this Sunday; see forecast
en.summary: São Paulo state is under alert for dangerous storm conditions on Sunday.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: veja a agenda dos candidatos ao Governo do Maranhão neste domingo (13)

en.title: 2026 Elections: see the agenda of candidates for Maranhão Governor this Sunday (13)
en.summary: Eight candidates for Maranhão governor have begun their 2026 election campaign activities, with their schedules published daily by coordinating parties.

stories.title: Inscrições para concurso da Polícia Civil da Bahia com 750 vagas encerram neste domingo (13)

en.title: Applications for Bahia Civil Police competition with 750 openings close this Sunday (13)
en.summary: Registration for Bahia's civil police public competition offering 750 positions closes Sunday, with positions including delegados, escrivães, and investigators at various salary levels.

stories.title: Lituânia pede à população que encontre abrigo após alerta de invasão por drone; Otan aciona caças na região

en.title: Lithuania asks population to seek shelter after drone invasion alert; NATO activates fighters in region
en.summary: Lithuania closed its main airport and NATO scrambled fighter jets in response to a suspected Russian drone sighting in Lithuanian airspace. Residents in the capital were advised to take shelter.

stories.title: São Paulo segue em alerta de perigo para tempestades neste domingo (13)

en.title: São Paulo remains on alert for storms this Sunday (13)
en.summary: Weather instability affecting São Paulo state is expected to continue on Sunday, following Saturday's storms that caused disappearances and flooding.

stories.title: Enamed será aplicado neste domingo; veja regras para estudantes de medicina

en.title: Enamed will be administered this Sunday; see rules for medical students
en.summary: Medical students across Brazil will take the Enamed national assessment exam on Sunday, which is mandatory for those completing their degrees and certain fourth-year students meeting criteria set by the education institute.

stories.title: Trens da linha 7-rubi vão funcionar com lentidão neste domingo (13) para retirada árvore dos trilhos

en.title: Line 7-rubi trains will operate slowly on Sunday (13) to remove tree from tracks
en.summary: The ruby line will operate with reduced speed and longer intervals on Sunday to remove a large tree that fell onto the tracks near Pirituba station in northern São Paulo.

stories.title: BRB diz ter sido ‘vítima de atos criminosos’

en.title: BRB says it was 'victim of criminal acts'
en.summary: Banco de Brasília claimed to be a victim of criminal conduct regarding purchases of Master bank portfolios. Seven directors, including the former CEO, allegedly committed fraudulent management across 25 operations totaling 17.5 billion reais.

stories.title: Wall Street dá alta de juros como certa e põe credibilidade do Fed à prova

en.title: Wall Street treats interest rate hike as certain and tests Fed's credibility
en.summary: Market participants intensified bets on a Federal Reserve interest rate increase for the following Wednesday, marking the first hike since July 2023. The shift puts the central bank's credibility and new leadership under scrutiny amid broader economic challenges.

stories.title: ‘O feminismo precisa ser contra o radicalismo’, diz a psicanalista Betty Milan

en.title: 'Feminism needs to be against radicalism', says psychoanalyst Betty Milan
en.summary: Psychoanalyst Betty Milan discusses her views on feminism and its relationship with radicalism.
